subject.summary: One run of NetLogo's Wolf Sheep Predation. A phase portrait rising in time: across the floor count sheep, front to back count wolves, height is ticks; its shadow on the floor is the classic phase plot, and the two walls carry each against time.

sources.title: A construct of a NetLogo run
A run of Wolf Sheep Predation (NetLogo 7.0.4, random-seed 11), recorded with construct.nls

facts.value: Y is up. The floor is the two reporters, 10 m across its longer side; height is time, 6 m from tick 0 to tick 1500.
a centred moving average over 25 records
